messages:
nina: quick sync — daily standup (GPU ops). What I did: checked AMS/US-west headroom; patched node image in gpu-pool-ams1. Blockers: waiting on quota bump for eu-west-3 (ticket ACC-842). Today: coordinate fallbacks + prewarm for canary.

samir: provisioning update — headroom snapshot: ams1 +18 GPUs, usw2 +6, euw3 -2 (overcommitted). If euw3 quota doesn't land, spot fallback needs to absorb ~8 replicas.

lee: quick q — can we move nonprod batch to us-west to free ~6 GPUs? @samir @nina

maria: ACC-842 still on hold; cloud billing needs a contact. I've DM'd finance. Can we reroute the canary to ams1 for the short term?

ops-bot: [alert] 2026-03-17T14:03Z — eviction rate high on euw3 spot pool: 12% (5m avg).

alex: mitigation plan: scale down 'exp-batch' in euw3 by 3 GPUs and spin up 3 in ams1. Command I'll run in 10m: `./ctl scale-pool exp-batch --region euw3 --down 3 && ./ctl scale-pool exp-batch --region ams1 --up 3`

samir: ack. tagging @lee to confirm batch can tolerate move. I'll also add a temporary routing rule to prefer ams1 for canary: `route-policy canary -> ams1` (ttl 15m).

lee: ok from infra side. :thumbsup:

nina: thanks all — if ACC-842 not cleared by 17:30 UTC we'll proceed with alex's plan and I'll update the ticket & notify CS. :wave:
